title: AC 05.1 – Course Required – Creation blocked when course field is null
description: AC 05 — Equivalence Partitioning (Critical Risk) — Lesson creation is blocked when required Course field is null or not selected.
preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC (Teacher Availability Calendar)
Create Lesson form is open
Course field is visible and marked as required
Courses available in system: ["Course A", "Course B", "Course C"]
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to Riso TAC and click Create Lesson button"
2. "Verify Course field is empty/null"
3. "Attempt to submit form without selecting Course"
4. "Verify validation error message displayed"
5. "Verify lesson is NOT created in database"
steps_result:
1. "Create Lesson form opens with empty Course field"
2. "Course field shows no value selected"
3. "Form submission rejected or blocked"
4. "Error message shown (e.g., Course is required) or create button disabled"
5. "Query lesson table; no orphaned record created"

title: AC 05.2 – Course Required – Creation allowed when course field is populated

preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff
Location: Riso TAC
Create Lesson form is open
Course field is required and visible
Courses configured: ["Course A", "Course B", "Course C"]
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to Riso TAC and click Create Lesson button"
2. "Select "Course A" from Course dropdown"
3. "Fill other required fields (Subject, Teacher, Date/Time, Location)"
4. "Submit form by clicking Save/Create button"
5. "Verify lesson created in database and displayed on calendar"
steps_result:
1. "Create Lesson form opens"
2. "Course field populated with Course A"
3. "Form populated with valid values"
4. "Form submission accepted"
5. "Lesson record exists; visible on TAC"
steps_data:
1. "form_state = empty"
2. "course_value = Course A"
3. "form_complete = true"
4. "submit_action = click_save"
5. "lesson_created = true"

Location: Riso TAC with left sidebar visible
Sidebar contains Course section + Timeslot section (scrollable)
Timeslots displayed: 5 rows (e.g., 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00)

2. "Verify Course section visible at top of sidebar"
3. "Verify Timeslot section below Course with 5 rows"
4. "Scroll down in Timeslot section (vertical scroll)"
5. "Verify Course section header remains visible (sticky)"
steps_result:
1. "TAC loads with sidebar layout visible"
2. "Course field/header displayed"
3. "5 timeslot rows visible"
4. "Timeslot content scrolls"
5. "Course header does NOT scroll out of view; fixed position maintained"

title: AC 05.5 – Japanese Date Format – Calendar displays date as 7月1日 (no slash)

preconditions:
User role: HQ/CM Staff or Teacher
Location: Riso TAC
Locale set to Japanese (JP)
Calendar showing lessons with dates
Date range includes July 1st, 2026
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to Riso TAC with JP locale"
2. "Verify calendar header or date display"
3. "Locate a date entry (e.g., July 1st)"
4. "Verify date format is "7月1日" (no slash)"
5. "Verify no slash character present"
steps_result:
1. "TAC page loads with Japanese language settings"
2. "Calendar shows dates in Japanese format"
3. "Date visible on calendar"
4. "Date displays exactly as 7月1日 (not 7/1 or 7月1日/)"
